judgments.reason: Guger et al. 2009 is a P300 BCI study of 100 subjects. This dataset has 10 subjects, a BrainAmp amplifier and Schreuder/Tangermann as authors, so it is topically related but not the data paper.
judgments.paper_title: How many people are able to control a P300-based brain–computer interface (BCI)?

judgments.reason: Same authors and auditory ERP speller topic, but this study has N=21 subjects. The dataset has 10 subjects and cites a different DOI (Neurosci Lett 2009), so it is not clearly this dataset's paper.
judgments.paper_title: Listen, You are Writing! Speeding up Online Spelling with a Dynamic Auditory BCI

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used for dataset conversion, not a paper describing the BNCI 2015-003 P300 data.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
